nodes.label: Pipelined Batched Inference
nodes.rationale: 3-stage ThreadPoolExecutor pipeline overlaps disk decode, GPU forward, and disk write so the GPU never idles waiting on I/O (~2.5x).

nodes.label: AMP float16 Inference
nodes.rationale: torch.amp.autocast runs the forward pass in half precision to exploit GPU tensor cores.

nodes.label: Pinned Memory + non_blocking DMA
nodes.rationale: pin_memory() + .to(device, non_blocking=True) overlaps CPU->GPU transfers with compute.

nodes.label: Avoid torch.compile (Mask R-CNN incompatible)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic proposal counts + Tensor.item() graph breaks cause recompilation storms making compiled mode ~10x slower. The plan proposed torch.compile; PERFORMANCE.md documents reverting it.

nodes.label: cuDNN Warmup Pass
nodes.rationale: A startup warm-up batch at real image dims forces cuDNN autotuning so the first user request is not slow.

nodes.label: asyncio.to_thread Offloading
nodes.rationale: Mesh generation runs in a thread pool so the FastAPI event loop stays responsive to status polling and frame serving.

nodes.label: Streaming Chunked Upload
nodes.rationale: Reads the uploaded video 1MB at a time so peak memory stays constant regardless of file size.

nodes.label: Cached PNG Mask Serving
nodes.rationale: A .png is written next to each .tiff at inference time so the mask endpoint serves it directly (~1ms) instead of re-converting.
